# Verify a known Golomb ruler of order 9
marks = [0, 1, 5, 12, 25, 27, 35, 41, 44]
diffs = set()
ok = True
for i in range(len(marks)):
    for j in range(i+1, len(marks)):
        d = marks[j] - marks[i]
        if d in diffs:
            ok = False
            print(f"Duplicate distance {d} between {marks[i]} and {marks[j]}")
        diffs.add(d)
print("Marks:", marks)
print("Number of distances:", len(diffs))
print("All unique:", ok)
print("Sorted distances:", sorted(diffs))
